Commentary.Commentary: So, the target for Ireland is 185 in their 20 overs. They would need their batters to come good here and take this series to the decider. Stay tuned for the chase on the other side of the break.

Talking of the Irish bowling, they started well with the ball but once the batters had their eyes in, the ball was flying over the fence regularly. Overall the bowling was good at the start but fizzled out in the last ten overs and the Irish bowled in the right areas too. But credit goes to the Afghanistan batters as there was nothing much the Irish could do with the ball. They would also rue that their fielding was below par. They would now hope that their batters show some spirited effort and take them over the line.

Afghanistan live upto their skipper's word as he had said at the toss that they will look to put up a score on the board during the toss. The Afghan batters started slowly and steadily but soon picked up pace as the duo of Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz stitched a 57-run stand. Though Gurbaz's stay was cut short due to a well-effected run out but skipper Asghar Afghan and Mohammad Nabi joined forces and runs started to flow like a river flowing at its full glory. Both the experienced campaigners were involved in a 74-run stand which took the game away from the Irish bowlers. Afghan too departed well one short of his half ton but by then he had taken his side over to a above par total.
SIX! Yes, he can! What a finish from the Afghanistan batters. Full delivery on middle, Naib lofts it over long on for a biggie. 26 from the last over. AFGHANISTAN FINISH WITH 184/4!
SIX! Brilliant! This is turning out to be a big, big over for Afghanistan. Short delivery on middle, Naib pulls it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Can he finish with another maximum?
Short delivery on middle, Najibullah pulls it over mid-wicket for a run.
SIX! This is even better! Full delivery on middle, Zadran lofts it over long on for a biggie.
SIX! That is huge! Length delivery on off, Najibullah lofts it over the bowler's head for a maximum.
Short delivery on middle, Naib looks to pull but misses it and gets hit on the thigh pad. It goes towards the off side. The batsmen take a single. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Short and on middle, Zadran goes for the pull but can only manage to connect with thin air.
Full and on off, Naib drives it to mid on for a single.
Gulbadin Naib is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Afghan misses out on a well-deserved half ton. It is bowled full and around off, Afghan lofts it over mid on but he fails to get the elevation as the ball goes towards long on where Harry Tector takes a well judged catch right inside the ropes.
Short and down the leg side, Zadran plays it towards the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, Zadran looks to squeeze it out only to get beaten on the outside edge.
Full and on the leg stump, Afghan misses the flick. The ball goes off the pads towards square leg. A single.
On a good length on leg, Afghan looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Full delivery on off, Zadran drives it through mid off for a run.
Good length delivery outside off, Zadran looks to go after it but misses it.
Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length on middle, Zadran flicks it through square leg for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Najibullah Zadran is the new man in. Also, there is a bowling change as Joshua Little comes back on. 2-0-13-0 so far from him.

OUT! CAUGHT! Nabi departs! Short delivery on middle, Nabi pulls it over square leg but does not get the timing on it. It goes towards the fielder where Dockrell takes a good catch in the deep. End of an excellent partnership between Nabi and Afghan.
On a length on middle, Nabi flicks it through square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
Short delivery on middle, Nabi pulls it over square leg but does not get the distance on it. It goes towards the fielder where he takes the catch but it will not matter as it was a Free Hit.

NO BALL! NOT OUT! Full delivery on off, Afghan looks to loft it over mid off but gets a top edge. It goes towards mid off where the Balbirnie takes the catch. The Irish players start celebrating but the on-field umpire go upstairs to check for a No Ball. The replays then roll in and show that Rankin has overstepped by a big margin. A Free Hit will follow.
The umpire has gone upstairs for a No Ball check as the catch has been taken cleanly. Let's see what the replays show. Ohh! That is a huge No Ball.
Full delivery on middle, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Nicely played! On a length on middle, Nabi flicks it through square leg for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, Nabi pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a couple.
SIX! That is huge! Full delivery on middle, Afghan lofts it over long on for a maximum. 25 runs from the over. A highly productive one for Afghanistan.
FOUR! Afghan is on a carnage. Short ball outside off, Afghan opens the face of the bat and cuts it uppishly over the slip cordon to fetch a boundary at third man.
SIX! Floated and on off, Afghan lofts it handsomely over long on and clears the fence with ease.
FOUR! Misfield there. Poor from the Irish fielder. Afghan lofts it towards mid-wicket. The ball goes on the bounce towards the fielder but it goes between his legs for a boundary.
Short and on off, pulled to short mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR!  LEG BYES! A loud appeal but to no avail. It is bowled full and outside off, Nabi looks to flick it but it goes of the bat and past the keeper and into the third man fence.
Craig Young is back on. 2-0-4-0 are his figures so far.
Floated and on  the pads, Nabi tucks it towards square leg for a single.
Full and on middle, pushed towards long on for a run.
Floated and on the pads, flicked towards mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Nabi is into his zone. It is floated and on middle, Mohammad pulls it with disdain over the deep mid-wicket fence for a single.
Full and on off, pushed back to the bowler.
Floated on off, pushed towards mid off.
Full toss on middle, Afghan lofts it over mid on. It goes towards the long on fielder who collects it on one bounce. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR! This is even better! Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it towards the deep mid-wicket region to get the third boundary of the over.
FOUR! Good shot! Short of a length delivery, Afghan waits and pulls it over mid-wicket for a boundary.
SIX! Amazing shot! Short delivery on leg, Afghan pulls it over square leg for a maximum.
On a length on middle, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it through square leg for a single.
Boyd Rankin is back on. 2-0-7-0. So far from him.
Short delivery on middle, Afghan pulls it through mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Nabi drives it through mid on for a single.
Floated delivery on off, Nabi blocks it well.
FOUR! Hammered! Short delivery on middle, Nabi pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Loopy delivery on middle, Afghan flicks it towards mid-wicket for a run.
WIDE! Delany bowls it down the leg side, Afghan looks to flick but misses it.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Nabi flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Mohammad Nabi is the next batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Gurbaz goes against the run of play. Big mix up there. Afghan is the culprit there. Rahmanullah was going so well there but a miscommunication from them and he has to take the long walk back. Young dishes a full paced yorker and Gurbaz digs it out towards the off side. Afghan calls for a single and Young who is in his followthrough hares towards the ball and looks to score a direct hit but then decides against it as he sees his skipper running towards the bowler's end from extra cover. He throws the ball to him and Balbirnie there whips the bails off. The umpire takes it upstairs and the replays show that even the full length dive from Gurbaz could not save him.
A run out check! It is referred upstairs. Rahmanullah Gurbaz is the man in question. It seems out. Let's see what happens.
Full and on middle, slogged towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short ball on leg, Afghan looks to pull but he connects it with thin air.
Slower ball outside off, pushed to point for a single.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side, Gurbaz misses the pull but he fails to connect. Wided.
Short ball outside off, Gurbaz looks to pull but the ball goes underneath the bat and towards the keeper.
BEATEN! Full and outside off, Gurbaz looks to lay bat on ball but he fails to get anything behind it.
Craig Young is back on. 1-0-1-0 are his figures so far.
Full and on middle, Gurbaz pushes it to mid on for a single.
Tossed up on leg, Afghan flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Flatter and on off, cut straight to point where Paul Stirling fields it.
Floated and around off, pushed to covers for a single.
SIX! Beautiful swing of the bat. It is floated on off, Gurbaz pulls it over the deep mid-wicket fence for a biggie as the fielder there is a mere spectator.
Tossed up delivery on off, Gurbaz comes down the track and drives it towards covers.
Full and on the pads, Gurbaz flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Once again, it is short and on the body, Afghan looks to pull but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards mid-wicket for a single.
Another short ball on middle, Gurbaz pulls it to mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Short and in middle, pulled towards fine leg for a single.
Full and outside off, Gurbaz drives it through covers where the fielder cuts it off. Just a single.
On a length on middle, Afghan flicks it through square leg for a single.
Joshua Little is back on. 1-0-7-0 are his figures so far.
Loopy delivery on middle, Afghan flicks it through square leg for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Afghan defends it off the back foot.
Asghar Afghan is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Brilliant take by the bowler off his own bowling. Delany floats one on the pads of Zazai. Zazai at the last moment checks his shot as he looks to flick it. The  ball flies off the blade and to the left of the bowler. Delany runs to that side and pulls out a stunner as he takes it just inches above the turf with his left hand. He had got off to a start but he needed to continue.
Full and on off, Gurbaz pushes it to long on for a single.
SIX! Floated and in the arc for Gurbaz. He just lofts it handsomely over long on for a big hit. It sailed into the crowd there.
Floated on off, pushed towards mid-wicket.
Gareth Delany is on now.
Good length delivery on off, Zazai keeps it out.
On a length on leg, Zazai looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards fine leg. The batsmen get two runs. The umpire gives it as a leg bye. 50 up for Afghanistan.
Full delivery on off, Zazai drives it towards mid off.
On a good length on middle, Gurbaz looks to flick but gets it off the pads. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen cross ends. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Length delivery on off, Gurbaz plays it to point.
On a length on middle, Zazai flicks it through square leg for a single.
Craig Young is into the attack.
Floated on the pads, Gurbaz tucked it to the leg side for a couple.
Flatter and on off, Zazai punches it off the back foot through the off side for a single.
Floated and on off, Zazai pushes it to the off side.
WIDE! Full and wide outside off, Zazai looks to cut but misses it. Wided.
Full and on middle, pushed to mid on for a single.
Floated and on middle, Zazai looks to flick it to the leg side but gets an inside edge towards square leg for a single.
SIX! Floated on off, Zazai takes the aerial route as he lofts it over mid on and into the fence at long on for a maximum.
George Dockrell is on now.
Length delivery on middle, Zazai punches it towards mid on for a single. End of the Powerplay. Afghanistan are 34/0.
On a length on off, Zazai plays it to point.
Full delivery on middle, Zazai drives it towards mid on.
Full again on off, Zazai drives it to covers.

DROPPED! That can prove to be costly! Full delivery on off, Zazai looks to loft it over covers but gets a top edge. It goes towards the point fielder where he runs and tries to take the catch but spills it. The batsmen get two runs. Will Zazai make Ireland pay for this?
Short delivery on middle, Zazai pulls it through mid-wicket. The batsmen get two runs.
Boyd Rankin is back on. 1-0-2-0 so far from him.
Loopy delivery on middle, Zazai lofts it over mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Gurbaz drives it through mid on for a run.
Flighted delivery on middle, Zazai looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. It goes towards third man. The batsmen take a single. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Full and on off, pushed towards long on for a single.
SIX! That is as clean as a whistle. Floated around off, Gurbaz stands and lofts it high and handsome over wide long on for a biggie.
Floated around off, Zazai drives it towards long on for a single.
On a length on middle, Zazai flicks it through square leg for a single.
FOUR! That is put away with disdain! Short delivery on middle, Zazai pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
FOUR! Hammered! Short delivery on middle, Zazai rocks on his back foot and then pulls it through square leg for a boundary.

Length delivery on middle, Zazai tucks it towards mid-wicket where Gurbaz wants the run but Zazai sends him back. The keeper picks up the ball and goes for a direct hit at the bowler's end but misses it.
On a length on middle, Zazai looks to flick it but gets it off the inside half of the bat. The ball goes towards deep square leg. The batsmen get two runs.
On a good length on off, Zazai plays it back towards the bowler.
Joshua Little is into the attack.
Tossed up delivery on middle, Zazai drives it through mid on for a run.
Full delivery on middle, Gurbaz drives it through mid on for a single.
Floated delivery on middle, Gurbaz flicks it through square leg. Joshua Little in the deep does well to stop it. The batsmen pick up a couple.
Loopy delivery on off, Gurbaz plays it to covers.
Floated and around middle, Zazai flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Floated on off and middle, Zazai looks to tuck it to the leg side but get rapped on the pads. The bowler appeals but it is of no use.
Simi Singh is on.
Length delivery on off, Zazai plays it towards covers for a run.
On a length on middle, Gurbaz flicks it through square leg for a single.
Good length delivery on off, Gurbaz defends it off the front foot.
BEATEN! On a good length and outside off, Gurbaz looks to defend but misses it.
Good length delivery on off, Gurbaz keeps it out.
On a good length on middle, Zazai looks to flick but gets hit on the thigh pad. It goes towards the leg side. The batsmen take a single. The umpire gives it as a leg bye.
Tossed up delivery on leg, Gurbaz looks to sweep but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head. Good start from Stirling. Only 3 from the first over.
Floated delivery on middle, Zazai flicks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy delivery on middle, Zazai drives it towards mid on.
Full delivery on middle, Gurbaz drives it through mid on for a run.
Zazai and Afghanistan are underway!!! Floated delivery on middle, Zazai flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Stirling starts with a tossed up delivery on off, Zazai defends it off the front foot.
We are all set to begin. The Ireland players are out in the middle. Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz follow them out to the middle. Paul Stirling will start for the visitors.

Ireland skipper, Andy Balbirnie says that they would have bowled first looking at the surface. He says that they did not play the strokes from the middle of the bat and would look to rectify it today.
Afghanistan skipper, Asghar Afghan says that they will bat first. He says that the wicket is good and they want to put up a score on board.

Pitch Report - Ajay Mehra is there for the pitch report. He says that the tinge of the grass is much more brownish and the track is very good to bat on. Adds that the captains will not hesitate to bat on this wicket.

Ireland (Unchanged Playing XI) - Andy Balbirnie (c), Gareth Delany, Paul Stirling, Kevin O'Brien, Simi Singh, Harry Tector, Lorcan Tucker (wk), Craig Young, George Dockrell, Boyd Rankin, Joshua Little.

Afghanistan (Unchanged Playing XI) - Hazratullah Zazai, Najibullah Zadran, Asghar Afghan (c), Rahmanullah Gurbaz (wk), Samiullah Shinwari, Mohammad Nabi, Gulbadin Naib, Karim Janat, Rashid Khan, Shapoor Zadran, Mujeeb Ur Rahman.
TOSS - It is time for the spin of the coin. Afghanistan win the toss and elect to bat.

Hello and welcome to the 2nd T20I between Afghanistan and Ireland in Greater Noida. The Irish will be a shade disappointed after the outcome of the last match which was assisted by the rain gods. They did reasonably well in all the departments of the game but still ended on the wrong side of the result, mainly due to rain and also Najibullah Zadran's blitz with the bat. Today is a new day and there is very little to no chance of rain and hence they would be hopeful of winning this tie and take it to the decider. Afghanistan, on their part, would try to become more clinical with their performance and register a thumping win this time around to seal the series. Promises to be a close match. Stay tuned for the toss and the teams.
